app_info.subtitle: Continuity for AI agents
app_info.description: Organizational continuity for AI agents. Make AI work resumable, reviewable, and provable across agents. The task outlives the chat: OrgX lets the next agent continue from the decisions, artifacts, approvals, owners, and proof the last agent left behind. Users can search company context, inspect initiatives, review pending decisions, scaffold work, delegate agent tasks, and view interactive widgets for status and follow-up actions.

test_cases.description: Read the connected OrgX workspace context without selecting a workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start OrgX and show my workspace context.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns authorized workspace context and typed references without changing session selection or exposing OAuth credentials or human approval tokens.

test_cases.description: List the deterministic seeded decisions awaiting approval.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the pending decisions that need approval today.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the three seeded pending decisions with title, status, urgency or priority, and enough context to approve or reject.

test_cases.description: Search memory for a seeded initiative decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: What did we decide about Search Copilot readiness?

test_cases.description: Render initiative health for a seeded initiative.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the pulse for the Search Copilot Readiness initiative.
